comments.author: mDuo13
comments.body: Do we have an official policy on amendment support / ledger playback support yet? I think FeeEscalation doesn't affect "transaction processing" so much as "which transactions get the chance to be processed" but I'm hesitant to back any amendment retirement until we've published a policy on how it'll work.

prs.body:
This PR actually contains 3 mostly-unrelated commits, but retiring the amendment is the big one, so that's the title. The other two remove some undocumented, unused (AFAIK) experimental options from RPC `sign`, and remove the redundant precomputed hashes in `supportedAmendments()`. The hashes were ignored everywhere, except some setup work during startup, and it makes more sense to use the runtime computed hashes there.

For removing the FeeEscalation amendment, note that the amendment name itself remains "known". If I took that out of the list, every upgraded node on the mainnet would get amendment blocked!

reviewCommentsList.author: ximinez
reviewCommentsList.body: I tend to overprotect with "belt and suspenders". Long story short, when I dug in to that function, it looked like `view` should never be null, so I asserted, but because it would lead to a crash triggered by user action if it ever was, I added the check. If we keep both, the error should definitely be changed to `rpcINTERNAL` now, and the check should be moved to `doRPC` itself. Do you think the `BOOST_ASSERT` is sufficient?

reviewCommentsList.author: ximinez
reviewCommentsList.body: I don't think the curlies were _ever_ required. Fixed.

reviewCommentsList.author: nbougalis
reviewCommentsList.body:
I'm not sure how I feel about this because the check is redundant: the impementation of `OpenLedger` guarantees that `current` can _never_ be invalid. Having an `if` implies that it's possible and something to check for. An `assert` would be better suited because it communicates the "this can't happen!" nature of the check. I would be interested in knowing what others think?

Also, why `BOOST_ASSERT` over `assert`?

No change needed at this point.

reviewCommentsList.author: ximinez
reviewCommentsList.body: I kept the check because I wasn't 100% sure that it was impossible. If that's a known invariant, then I'll remove the check. There's no particular reason I used `BOOST_ASSERT` over `assert` - It's just habit.

reviewCommentsList.author: ximinez
reviewCommentsList.body: Oh, I just realized this is included in b6, so I won't make the change here.
